Recommend migrating peer-01 through peer-05 to tls13-hybrid-x25519-mlkem768 within the Tuesday 02:00-04:00 UTC change window, with the on-call network team monitoring handshake error rates for 30 minutes post-change per standard procedure; peer-06 remains on the current profile pending a capability upgrade.
